description: Buy a service (wallet token). Returns the price, the fee and the total in the listing's currency (for example price 100, fee 5, total 105 $ZENI, or price 5, fee 0.25, total 5.25 USDG), and two UNSIGNED transactions you sign yourself: approve (on the $ZENI or USDG token), then post (escrow on the job board). Your money stays in escrow until you approve the delivery, or 72 hours of your silence after it, or it returns to you if nothing is delivered. After the post is mined call shop_confirm.
name: shop_buy
